title: Friday Daily Practice: weekly test /19
subtitle: Weekly test on Lesson 7 (45 minutes, no notes)
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 5 (B7 Other people's habits, B8 Putting it all together + Phase A test), Fri 13 Nov (weekly test)
intro: Weekly test /19, about 45 minutes, no notes, no phone dictionary. Steps 1 to 4 are the test. Step 5 is a voice note. Deadline: 23:00 the same day. Step 3 has an audio: press Listen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What time do you wake up?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I wake up at half past six.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What time does your bus leave?

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What time do you start work?

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A

steps.title: Step 1 · Test A: words /5
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with a Lesson 7 word. Change the form if needed.

items.label: 1. She goes to bed at 1 a.m. every night. She is a night ____.
2. I never eat in the morning. I always ____ breakfast.
3. My dad cuts the grass. He ____ the lawn every Saturday.
4. He works too much. Be careful, he can ____ out.
5. Please ____ these bottles. Put them in the green bin.

steps.title: Step 2 · Test B: grammar /6
steps.instructions: Write the correct form. Use doesn't or Does where you see (not) or (?).

items.label: 6. How often ____ he go to the gym? (?)

steps.title: Step 3 · Test C: listening /4
steps.instructions: Listen to Lan and Minh. Write the 4 times you hear in numbers (for example 6:30). You can listen two times.

steps.title: Step 4 · Test D: writing /4
steps.instructions: Write 3 sentences about your friend's habits and 1 question with How often. Type it in the box on the website.

open.model: My friend Nam is an early bird. He usually goes running at six. He doesn't skip breakfast. How often does he go to the gym?

ai.type: Three sentences and one question about a friend's habits
ai.task: Write 3 sentences about a friend's habits and 1 How often question. 1 point for each correct sentence.
criteria: 3 correct sentences with he or she and the -s / -es / -ies ending (1 point each)
1 correct question: How often does he/she + base verb? (1 point)
capital letters, full stops and a question mark

steps.title: Step 5 · Voice note
steps.instructions: Read your 4 sentences from Step 4 aloud. Record one voice note.
lines: Read your 4 sentences from Step 4 aloud, slowly.
steps.note: Not scored. Teacher listens for the -s endings.

send_today: Test on the website. Press Submit when you finish. Voice note in step 5 is sent to the teacher.
